Name: Loafy's Little Farm
Author: loafeon
Description:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/n4XdwZb.png[/img]﻿[list]
[*][size=2][b][u][CP] & [CFL] options available[/u][/b][/size]
[*][size=2]45 x 30 Tiles Farm layout[/size]
[*][size=2]A layout with barns & coops in mind![/size]
[*][size=2]Space for your craftables right by the farm house﻿[/size]
[*][size=2]Play co-op with a friend! [/size]
[*][size=2][CP] Modify farm replacement through the config file - Replaces [b][u]Forest Farm[/u][/b] by default[/size]
[/list]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/ad9prRZ.png[/img]
﻿
[list]
[*][size=2]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]﻿[/size]
[*][size=2]Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url][/size]
[*][size=2]Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13804]Custom Farm Loader[/url]﻿ (if using CFL version)﻿[/size]
[*][size=2]Extract into your \Stardew Valley\Mods\ folder[/size]
[/list][size=2]
[i]*I suggest utilizing [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16873]Easy Farm Switcher[/url] for prior save files*[/i]
[/size]﻿
[img]https://i.imgur.com/hxvaHeU.png[/img]

﻿[size=2][b]1.0.0[/b] - Farm created!﻿
﻿[b]1.0.1[/b] - Minor bug fixes, tile updates, & update key added to manifest.json
﻿[b]1.0.2[/b] - compatible with recolor mods
﻿[b]1.0.3[/b] - removed untillable island grass tiles 
﻿[b]1.0.4[/b] - created CFL version with red mushroom, snail, & forest forage daily spawns! fixed greenhouse dirt tiles, moved left fence posts back, moved co-op house
﻿[b]1.0.5[/b] - reverted back to original name to help with prior save files, decreased spawn rate of CFL items, changed starter farmhouse furniture, changed default replacement farm to Forest Farm, adjusted unreachable tiles to never spawn items
﻿
[/size]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/yV6ETQk.png[/img]
[size=2]
﻿﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23293]Loafy's Little Garden Farm[/url]

﻿More pocket sized & small farm layouts are coming soon! Keep an eye out :3
[/size]
